label: Good qua role, human good, good in a respect and good simpliciter
term: good qua role, human good, good in a respect and good simpliciter
resolution: The Aristotle role reading concerns competent exercise of an already specified function, not the choice or justification of a human function. His human-good conclusion concerns excellent rational activity over a complete life. Aquinas q.5 ad 1 concerns ultimate due perfection for goodness simpliciter and explicitly allows a merely actual subject to be good only in a respect. The existing q.5 co. GoodIn/Has reading is per perfection; q.94 GoodAct is practical good apprehended by practical reason. None of these predicates or domains is silently identified; no inference from role success or bare actuality to categorical moral obligation is supplied. See docs/notes/natural-goodness-function-and-authority.md.
